investment_theses.thesis: Nvidia outperformance vs. semiconductor peers (SOX, MU, QCOM) will narrow by year-end 2026 as AI capex cycle peaks and regulatory risk (export controls, Senate scrutiny) materializes.

CoinDesk: 'Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return'
CNBC: 'U.S. adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist over export control concerns amid Nvidia controversy'
